headline: Tu empresa opera en varias monedas. Tu tesorería no debería operar a ciegas.
imageIntent: Una cuenta corporativa con compartimentos USD, EUR y MXN abre y cierra la serie.
carouselDesignBlock: Create a white-background Xending system visual for a global treasury and multicurrency control concept, using an operational route language without naming any specific subject or scene. The composition must feel corporate, premium, institutional, modern, technological, and B2B, with a single clear visual hierarchy, 80–90% white space, and only 1–3 restrained secondary accents. Use a clean editorial layout with a dominant central flow, subtle structural navy elements (#0F1419) as the control framework, teal (#2ED4C7) as the activation/solution signal, and coral (#FF7A4A) as the only tension or status accent. Keep the palette mostly white (#FFFFFF) with very light gray support (#F5F5F5), no dark background, no heavy gradients, no busy composition, and no decorative clutter. The visual should suggest layered control, separation, and centralization through a minimal route system, with thin curves, small nodes, and a single focal interruption that resolves into a clearer controlled flow. Camera treatment: clean isometric or slightly elevated three-quarter view, premium product-visual clarity, soft studio lighting, realistic soft shadows, sharp edges, subtle depth, and generous negative space. Materiality: refined matte white, satin acrylic, light gray structural surfaces, precise bevels, and clean micro-reflections; no toy look, no plastic sheen, no low-poly geometry, no cyberpunk or neon styling. Typography rules only if text were present: Montserrat Bold or ExtraBold for headline, Poppins Medium or SemiBold for body/CTA, flat vector-like, matte, crisp, vertical axis, slightly tight tracking; however, because textInImage is false, include no readable text, labels, numbers, or logos of any kind. The composition must remain abstract and reusable across multiple pieces, with a restrained route motif that implies multicurrency coordination, visibility, and centralization without depicting any concrete business object or scene.
